rule.shared: Every probe asks about the asker's own private particulars and names at least one invented proper noun, so it is unanswerable by construction for any vault but that one person's.
rule.out_of_domain: Subject matter no knowledge vault is built around. These derive the high edge, because the high edge is meant to be the ceiling of the clearly-absent distribution.
rule.near_miss: Deliberately close to knowledge-work subject matter. Held out from edge derivation and used only to check the derived edge is not over-confident. Embeddings key on words like dashboard, deploy and migration, so an invented proper noun barely moves these; that is the point. Including them in the derivation conflates the ambiguous middle with the absent floor and pushes p95 up into the answerable distribution.
